Callout.Name: Crushing Injury
Callout.Message: Person crushed by machinery, now released.
Callout.Advisory: Casualty on the ground, colleagues keeping pressure.

Script.Line: It came down on the leg and they got me out with a jack.
Do not take the coat off. It is keeping the blood in.
I can feel my toes. Tell me that means something.

Callout.Patient: I can feel it. That is good, they told me that is good.

Lines.Approach: They have got him out from under it and his mate is holding a coat over the leg.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
